# depiction audience

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:depictionAudience`](gmeow-depictionAudience.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/depictionAudience>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

The audience or scope for which the depiction is intended — an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), a [`Group`](../classes/gmeow-Group.md)/Family, or a locale community. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to admit all of them. Non-functional: a depiction may be intended for multiple audiences.
